## Uninstall
**Settings → Plugins → Installed**, click the trash icon on the `dsh-session-menu` row and confirm.
## Settings
Once installed, the plugin adds a **Session menu** section under Settings with 8 switches:
Mark as unread · Copy · Show in file manager · Open with · Delete session · Delete all archived sess
ions · Status dots · Hover card
Turning one off hides it from the context menu and the session rows **immediately** — no restart. Th

e
switches live in this browser.
The triangle next to **Copy** and **Open with** expands them, so every sub-item can be switched on i

ts
own; turning a parent off greys its children out.
**Copy Session ID** is newer than this plugin in the kernel itself: when the kernel already ships th

at row, our
identical sub-item starts switched off and **Copy** collapses into a single row. Switch
it back on to keep both.
> Running a community build that already ships some of these? Turn the duplicates off here.
